_note: Claude Code's hook EVENTS — the lifecycle points a hook can attach to. A static reference catalog, not sourced from any registered llm-source and never executed by this server. Hooks that sources actually declare are in hooks.json alongside this file.

events.name: PreToolUse
events.description: Before a tool call runs; can block it or ask for approval

events.name: PostToolUse
events.description: After a tool call completes successfully

events.name: PostToolUseFailure
events.description: After a tool call fails

events.name: PostToolBatch
events.description: After a batch of tool calls completes

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.description: When a tool call requires a permission decision

events.name: PermissionDenied
events.description: When a permission decision refuses a tool call

events.name: SessionStart
events.description: When a session starts or resumes — the usual place to load context

events.name: SessionEnd
events.description: When a session ends

events.name: Setup
events.description: Environment setup for a session

events.name: InstructionsLoaded
events.description: After instruction files (CLAUDE.md and friends) are loaded

events.name: ConfigChange
events.description: When configuration changes during a session

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.description: When the user submits a prompt, before the model sees it

events.name: UserPromptExpansion
events.description: When a submitted prompt is expanded

events.name: Stop
events.description: When the main agent finishes responding

events.name: StopFailure
events.description: When the main agent stops because of a failure

events.name: MessageDisplay
events.description: When a message is displayed

events.name: Notification
events.description: When Claude Code raises a notification

events.name: SubagentStart
events.description: When a subagent starts; `matcher` selects by agent name

events.name: SubagentStop
events.description: When a subagent finishes

events.name: TaskCreated
events.description: When a task is created

events.name: TaskCompleted
events.description: When a task completes

events.name: TeammateIdle
events.description: When a teammate session goes idle

events.name: PreCompact
events.description: Before the conversation is compacted

events.name: PostCompact
events.description: After the conversation is compacted

events.name: Elicitation
events.description: When input is elicited from the user

events.name: ElicitationResult
events.description: When an elicitation is answered

events.name: DirectoryAdded
events.description: When a directory is added to the session

events.name: CwdChanged
events.description: When the working directory changes

events.name: FileChanged
events.description: When a watched file changes

events.name: WorktreeCreate
events.description: When a git worktree is created

events.name: WorktreeRemove
events.description: When a git worktree is removed
